column1: # truthy-zero-triage.tsv — the loop's memory of which `<numeric> || <nonzero>`
# sites have already been JUDGED, so future iterations don't re-eyeball the same
# safe defaults. Consumed by find-truthy-zero.mjs: a scanned site NOT listed here
# reads as NEW and trips `--check` (exit 1), forcing a human to judge it.
# A site is a BUG when 0 is a LEGITIMATE value for that field (a gap, a start
# timecode, an offset, a level, a count-from-zero) — then `|| N` silently eats it.
# A site is SAFE when 0 is not a meaningful input (it's clamped away by a
# Math.max/clamp with a positive lower bound, or 0 makes no sense for the field),
# OR the `||` is applied to a STRING (an input `.value`), where only the EMPTY
# string triggers the default and a typed "0" is truthy and survives.
#   SNIPPET-KEY = the whitespace-stripped snippet the scanner emits (stable across
#     line moves; run `find-truthy-zero.mjs --emit-ledger` to regenerate keys).
#   STATUS = SAFE (judged a non-bug) | BUG (open — fix it, then flip to SAFE).
# Add a row the moment you finish judging a site. Keep reasons short.

column4: UI slider populate on shape-select; strokeWidth never 0 (created positive, slider min ≥1) — cosmetic read, not data
UI slider populate; star points never 0 (min ≥2) — cosmetic read
clamp(Number(s.score)||1,1,5) — score range 1-5, 0 not a valid score
timebase is the fps rate denominator; 0 is invalid XML
parseFloat(#seq-fps.value)||23.976 — sequence fps; 0 fps invalid (3 call sites)
parseInt(#max-words?.value||16) — `||` on the STRING value; typed "0" is truthy and survives, only empty→16; SRT word-cap, 0 invalid anyway
parseInt(#max-duration?.value||5) — `||` on the STRING value; typed "0" survives; SRT duration cap, 0 invalid anyway
BoxGeometry width (ft) of a landscape element; a 0-ft-wide pool/deck/etc is geometrically degenerate (zero-volume, invisible) — not a meaningful value, 8ft is the sensible fallback for an unset dim
BoxGeometry length (ft) of a landscape element; a 0-ft-long element is degenerate (same as wFt); 8ft fallback for an unset dim
